text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in inference errors for dedicated-region-eu (service: inference-proxy). Error rate exceeded 4% for 2 consecutive mins. Paging rotation.

sre-leads: I saw the alert. Opening war room: https://meet.redwood.com/warroom/8b7c2d (password redwood!) — pinning link.

kevin.o: I'm responding to pager. Oncall here. Can take lead for infra actions. Who wants comms?

leila.m: I'll handle customer/status comms. Assigning engineering lead for triage: @samir.t? @samir.t you good to own root cause?

samir.t: Taking ownership for triage. Initial ask: log tails + recent deploys. Any recent rollouts to EU dedicated pool?

oncall-sre: No infra deploys in the last 20m. Noted a config push to routing rules 30m ago by ops-bot but flagged as non-breaking.

kevin.o: Quick mitigation plan: 1) open extra pods in fallback-cluster-eu, 2) divert 15% traffic to fallback, 3) enable degraded-mode that disables long-context caching to reduce memory pressure.

samir.t: Running log query for high latency traces and OOM/errors. Query:
```
logs query --service=inference-proxy --filter "status>=500" --start -15m
```

incident-bot: autoscale job initiated: job_id=sc-42f, target=+3 pods in fallback-cluster-eu, eta ~75s.

kevin.o: Applying traffic divert rule (canary 15%):
```
routerctl route set inference-proxy --region eu --fallback fallback-cluster-eu --pct 15
```

leila.m: Drafting status page note (internal preview):
```
Status: Degraded - elevated 5xx for inference API in EU dedicated clusters.
Impact: Some requests may fail or be slower. Affected: dedicated customers in EU region.
Workaround: We are diverting traffic to fallback capacity and scaling clusters. Engineers are investigating full cause.
ETA next update: 10 minutes.
```

samir.t: From traces, a small subset of requests contain huge prompt sizes (>50k tokens) causing backend workers to thrash and crash. KV-cache logs show eviction storms and restart spikes. Hypothesis: upstream client/regression sending very long contexts.

kevin.o: Can we throttle by request size at edge for now? Quick rule to reject requests >40k with 413 to protect cluster.

samir.t: Implementing size-gate at proxy with this rule:
```
proxyctl set-policy size_limit --service inference-proxy --max_tokens 40000 --response 413
```

incident-bot: policy apply confirmed: size_limit active.

leila.m: Customer notification templates ready. Short in-app banner: "We're investigating increased errors for inference in EU. Some requests may fail; mitigation in progress." Email template (long): "We detected elevated errors beginning at 12:50 UTC impacting inference in EU dedicated clusters. We have diverted traffic to fallback capacity and applied temporary rate/size protections. No data loss. Follow-up with root cause after RCA." 

kevin.o: After divert + size-gate, error rate dropped from 4.6% -> 1.3% within 3m. Still above baseline but improving. Keep canary at 15% for monitoring.

oncall-sre: Confirming there's no customer-facing deploy; good. Leila, can you hold external email until we confirm <1% for two windows? If <1% now within 10m, send short note.

leila.m: Yes holding. Posting status page as "investigating" now (internal preview ok). Will publish when Samir says stable.

samir.t: Observability action: capture heap profiles of workers that crashed, export a list of top client IDs by average prompt size, and snapshot cache hit ratio. I'm on those.

kevin.o: Canary metrics holding steady. p95 latency down from 900ms to 280ms after changes. Good.

incident-bot: status.redwood.com update pending. Draft saved: incident 1769016789 -> investigating.

samir.t: Found a client-side bug in a partner SDK that started sending concatenated histories — we'll reach out after we have a list. I can block offending client IDs with a temporary rule to prevent recurrence.

kevin.o: Apply client-block rule for top 3 offending client IDs for immediate protection. Command:
```
routerctl block-client --service inference-proxy --client-ids c-991,c-117,c-120 --duration 1h
```

incident-bot: block-client action accepted.

leila.m: Now that the immediate mitigation is effective, I'll publish the status page update and send an in-product banner to affected customers. Will include timing and note that we're monitoring.

leila.m: Posting update to status.redwood.com: state=investigating -> update published.

kevin.o: Metrics: 5xx at 0.6%, p95 260ms. Looks within SLO. Samir, do you want to keep proxy size gate for now or remove? 

samir.t: Keep it for another hour while we coordinate with partner. Also add an automated alert if prompt_size distribution median shifts >2x baseline.

oncall-sre: I'll take over monitoring and create follow-up ticket for RCA, partner outreach, and improved telemetry. Assigning to samir.t for lead on RCA.

kevin.o: Good. Wrapping up in-war-room actions. War room will stay open for 30m for any regressions. Handing ownership to oncall-sre for watch.

leila.m: Sending targeted email to affected customers now (short note + offer to set up call). Also posting internal exec update: TL;DR: transient errors caused by partner SDK bug sending huge contexts; mitigated via diversion, size gate, and client blocks.

samir.t: Summary for postmortem notes to paste later:
- Trigger: sudden influx of oversized prompts from partner SDK -> cache eviction + worker OOMs -> elevated 5xx
- Mitigations: divert traffic to fallback capacity, apply size gate, block top offending clients, scale fallback cluster
- Time to partial mitigation: ~8 minutes
- Next steps: RCA with partner, implement long-context detection and automated fallback, add alert on median prompt size and eviction spikes.

incident-bot: incident 1769016789 -> state: monitoring. Last update posted.

leila.m: Thanks everyone. I'll create the incident doc and link it here in #postmortems. Closing thread in 45m unless something else pops up."
